description.value: The Fountainhead Pub is one of Vancouver's original LGBTQ+ community pubs, situated in the heart of the Davie Village gayborhood in the West End. It features 17 draft beer lines spotlighting BC craft breweries, a full kitchen serving everything from pub classics to vegan-friendly bowls, and a patio that opens onto one of the city's most vibrant pedestrian streets. The pub has its own Wikipedia entry, reflecting its standing as a genuine neighbourhood landmark.
